sentences.en: The fire fighter demonstrated how to put out the fire.
sentences.zh: 消防员演示了如何扑灭火灾。

sentences.en: He went on to demonstrate how to use the machine.
sentences.zh: 他接着演示了如何使用这台机器。

sentences.en: The students observed as the teacher demonstrated the science experiment.
sentences.zh: 学生们观察老师演示科学实验的过程。

senses.zh: 说明, 演示 - 论证, 证明 - 显示, 表露

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（加强）+monstr（显示）+ ate（做）→加强显示→论证，说明
